programme.title: Royals: Keeping the Crown
programme.desc: Queen Victoria attempts to create peace in Europe through royal marriages; when three cousins linked by Victoria's royal blood turn against each other, and plunge Europe into the First World War, the Queen's dream of peace turns into a nightmare.

programme.title: Royals: Keeping the Crown
programme.desc: Royals across Europe embrace fascism; King George V knows he must keep his country safe from the dangers of Nazi Germany, but when his eldest son Edward VIII abandons royal duty for love, the Crown is thrown into a deep crisis.

programme.title: Royals: Keeping the Crown
programme.desc: World War II may be over, but it still casts a long shadow over royal families, particularly those with links to fascism; in Britain, King George VI works to keep his brother's closeness to the Nazis away from the British people.

programme.title: Royals: Keeping the Crown
programme.desc: Royals discover that breaking with tradition can get them in deep water, while other royals embrace change and manage to cling on to their crowns; during the 60s and 70s, royal culture meets celebrity culture, giving the Crown a popularity boost.

programme.title: Royals: Keeping the Crown
programme.desc: Queen Elizabeth has clung to power, but the royals' position is made all the more perilous as powerful anti-establishment voices in the press threaten to end the era of deference to royals.

programme.title: Royals: Keeping the Crown
programme.desc: To survive to see the future, the royal family must reinvent themselves; they ditch their "stiff upper lip" approach to appear more normal, in order to stay relevant and in touch with their subjects.

programme.desc: A young mob member goes into the Witness Protection Program and settles into a quiet suburban village, where he falls for a local woman and gets involved with cookie-making fund-raising for her daughter's scout troop while dodging his former associates who have tracked him down.

programme.title: Uncorked
programme.desc: A workaholic (Julie Benz) finds herself in unfamiliar territory after her schedule unexpectedly clears during a business trip to California's wine country. She starts spending time with a local chef (Scott Elrod) and his eccentric family, who try to teach her that there's more to life than work. JoBeth Williams and Elliott Gould also star. Directed by David Cass Sr.

programme.title: Grand Champion
programme.desc: Stock heart-warmer about a preteen cowboy (Jacob Fisher) and his prize steer on a quest to win a prestigious cattle show in Texas. Joey Lauren Adams, Cache Williams. Written and directed by Barry Tubb, the film features cameos by Bruce Willis and Julia Roberts (whose husband, Daniel Moder, handles the cinematography), and country stars George Strait, Robert Earl Keen and Natalie Maines, of the Dixie Chicks.

programme.title: Love Finds a Home
programme.desc: Dr. Belinda Owens (Sarah Jones) cares for her pregnant friend, whose opinionated mother-in-law (Patty Duke) resists Belinda's scientific approach to medicine. Adding to Belinda's worries is her own desire, but seeming inability, to become pregnant. Haylie Duff and Jordan Bridges also star. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: Reluctant Nanny
programme.desc: A lone officer desperately seeks a nanny for two children awaiting foster care, while Libby, jobless in LA, grapples with her future. Their paths cross due to a petty theft.

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Shadow on the Mesa
programme.desc: A gunslinger seeks out the father he never met while looking for answers about his mother's murder. When he arrives at his father's ranch, he finds himself in the middle of a war over the land.

programme.title: Mechanics of Love
programme.desc: Mattie, a tech entrepreneur who is home for her sisters wedding runs into Jake, a childhood friend who complicates her life.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: To save his family bakery, a Bronx baker (Costas Mandylor) with a flair for pastries partners with a talented Manhattan pastry chef (Lauren Holly) to enter a dessert competition with a $250,000 grand prize. Uncle Fabrizio: David Proval. Jim: Bruce Thomas. Jacques Du Jacques: Andy Lauer.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: After a lawyer (Jeremy London) proposes to his girlfriend (Dorie Barton), they head to her family's ranch for the holidays, where he must gain approval from her difficult dad (James Gammon) and cope with her scheming aunt (Sally Struthers), who informs her niece's ex-flame of the blossoming relationship. Mark Griffiths directed.

programme.title: Love Begins
programme.desc: An adventurer (Wes Brown) pays off a debt by working on a farm owned by a young woman (Julie Mond). As time passes and with nudging from the town's residents, the pair soon begin to fall for one another. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Love's Everlasting Courage
programme.desc: Farmer Clark Davis struggles to repay a loan and save his land during a drought. Making matters worse, his wife becomes gravely ill after agreeing to take a job in order to bring in more income.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: Marty is a 19 year old pioneer woman, recently married. She goes west with her husband Clem, hoping to start a new life. But Clem unexpectedly dies, and Marty finds herself alone, two months pregnant. Clark Davis, a widower, offers her a marriage of convenience: she needs food and money, and he needs someone to take care of his daughter Missie. She accepts his proposal as a temporary solution.

programme.title: Love's Enduring Promise
programme.desc: In this Janette Oke sequel to "Love Comes Softly," the eldest child in an 1800s frontier family, Missie Davis is a bright and beautiful elementary schoolteacher whose love for the prairie is matched only by her passion for books. When Missie encounters Grant, a handsome New England railroad executive, she feels as though shes met a hero from one of her novels.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie's surprise pregnancy sets her on a new course that is both thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie, have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Now, caught between the excitement of the new adventure and the pain of not knowing when she'll see her family again, Missie copes with the challenges, and cherishes the rewards, of her new homestead.

programme.title: Love's Abiding Joy
programme.desc: In this drama based on the fourth book in Janette Oke's best-selling "Love Comes Softly" series, Missie and Willie LaHaye (Erin Cottrell, Logan Bartholomew) get accustomed to rugged frontier life, but tragedy threatens to shake up their stable family. Michael Landon Jr. directed.

programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Missie three years later: being a single mother after her husband Willie was shot during a poker scuffle. She and Maddy move back in with her parents Clark and Marty. She finds a new home, and finds a new teaching position that she settles right into, but Missie has lost all faith in herself, until a chance encounter at her father's church where she adopts homeless orphan Belinda Marshall.

programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream
programme.desc: The sixth installment of the "Love Comes Softly" series follows the now-grown Belinda Tyler (Scout Taylor-Compton) as she struggles to choose between her career aspirations as a doctor and her feelings for a New York lawyer who wants a traditional wife. Clark: Dale Midkiff. Missie: Erin Cottrell.

programme.title: Love Takes Wing
programme.desc: A young doctor (Sarah Jones) moves to a town where a strange illness has stricken several residents, particularly those in the local orphanage. Despite their peril, the townspeople resist her efforts to help because she's a woman, so the doctor must find a way to save the town before it's too late. Haylie Duff, Cloris Leachman, Patrick Duffy. Directed by Lou Diamond Phillips, who also stars. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.desc: Stranded in 1955, Marty McFly learns about the death of Doc Brown in 1885 and must travel back in time to save him.

programme.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
programme.desc: Fired from her firm, a young Boston lawyer (Reese Witherspoon) heads to Washington, D.C., to fight for animal rights.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
programme.desc: With the annual Hunger Games approaching, 18-year-old Coriolanus Snow is assigned to mentor Lucy Gray Baird. Uniting their instincts for showmanship and political savvy, they race against time to ultimately reveal who's a songbird and who's a snake.

programme.title: Such Brave Girls
programme.desc: A decision from Dev puts Deb's plans for a better life on hold; Deb is treated to cream tea on Mother's Day, but recent news puts her off her scones; Josie is on a mission to get sectioned; Billie means business as Graham's sugar baby.

programme.title: Such Brave Girls
programme.desc: On the boat, Dev's confidence takes a knock and Deb does whatever it takes to get it back; Josie dodges Seb's attempts to take the next step; Billie proves her love life didn't end with Graham.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: In the 1950s, New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: Space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life-form in the universe while scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station.

programme.title: Kraven the Hunter
programme.desc: Kraven's complex relationship with his ruthless father starts him down a path of vengeance, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

programme.title: Being Maria
programme.desc: Maria, on the cusp of adulthood, stars in the cult classic "Last Tango in Paris." Unprepared, she's thrust into fame, becoming an iconic actress amidst glory and scandal.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Oscar kicks off the New Year with startling news about his national identity; the gang gets involved in a resolution contest.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Brent pleads with Hank not to embarrass him when they go to see Brent's favorite comic book writer.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash wants to make things right with Amira after their lives are turned upside down once again.

programme.title: Just for Laughs: All Access
programme.desc: Performances from Neal Brennan, Mae Martin, Stuart Goldsmith, and Myq Kaplan.

programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: A boy's close encounter with an alien stranded on Earth leads to a unique friendship in Steven Spielberg's Oscar-winning film.

programme.title: Princes of the Desert
programme.desc: Zodi, a young Berber boy, befriends an orphaned baby camel and together, they journey across the Sahara Desert.

programme.title: The Bad Guys
programme.desc: To avoid prison, a gang of notorious animal criminals pretends to seek being rehabilitated, only for their leader to realize that he genuinely wants to change his ways.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Branded a traitor, an elite intelligence agent (Tom Cruise) investigates a failed Prague mission to retrieve a computer disk.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible II
programme.desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called Chimera.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Now a trainer for IMF recruits, agent Ethan Hunt squares off against the toughest foe he has ever faced, a ruthless arms and information broker.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: The IMF is shut down when it's implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, causing Ethan Hunt and his new team to go rogue to clear their organization's name.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his team take on their most impossible mission yet to eradicate the Syndicate -- a highly skilled, international organization dedicated to creating a new world order via a series of terrorist attacks.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Fallout
programme.desc: An arms dealer and a group of terrorists plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack. When the weapons go missing, Ethan Hunt and the IMF team must race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.
